description: This file defines the DefaultFilter class within the Twig templating engine, specifically handling the 'default' filter functionality which provides a default value if a variable is undefined or empty.

classes.name: DefaultFilter
classes.description: A class that implements the 'default' filter for Twig templates, returning a default value when the input variable is undefined or empty.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DefaultFilter with the expression node, filter, arguments, and line number. Sets up the conditional logic for handling the 'default' filter behavior.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Builds the PHP code necessary to evaluate the filter when rendering a Twig template.
